_source: honey-beauty.md — re-checked 2026-11-10 against the live homepage HTML and its base stylesheet (style.css). Earlier values marked [inferred] were corrected where the live site disagreed.
_note: Reference values for honey-beauty.md are for layout/typography study only. MAJIDA keeps its own colour DNA (gold #D2AB2E, gold-deep #B8941F, charcoal #1C1A17, champagne #FAF6EC, ink #0B0B0B). Do not adopt the honey palette.

color._majida_only: All MAJIDA values live in styles/tokens.css. The honey values below are reference only.

bg.majida: --color-champagne (#FAF6EC) — landing bands use champagne-wash / porcelain / sand

accent.majida: --color-gold (#D2AB2E) on dark; --color-gold-deep (#5A450A) for text on light

_fonts.honey_observed: Cormorant Garamond (display, 400/500/600, italics) + Manrope (body/UI, 400–700) — verified from the Google Fonts link on the homepage
_fonts.majida: Frank Ruhl Libre (font-heading) for headings; Assistant (font-body) for body. Same job as the honey pair; do not switch.
_fonts.note: Both fonts are open (Google Fonts). The earlier guess of a licensed serif was wrong for the site's CSS. The honey pairing is a serif-display + geometric-sans pairing, which MAJIDA already matches in role.

display.majida: --type-display (matches; honey h1 uses a similar clamp)

eyebrow.majida: text-xs + tracking-widest (0.1em) — observed tracking is wider in absolute terms, so tracking-widest is the floor; keep it

index.observed: Honey's own numbering is small (.number ~10px, muted), so the large index is a MAJIDA layout choice, not a copy of their site

arrow-cta.observed: ↗︎ (with U+FE0E text presentation selector) on 48 outbound links; ↓ on in-page anchors

text-link.pattern: text link with 1px hairline underline (border-bottom, padding-bottom 8px), 11px

spacing.note: MAJIDA spacing tokens already cover the honey rhythm. No changes needed.

radius.observed: 0 on rectangles; 50% only on round icon buttons (verified in base stylesheet)
radius.majida: --radius-brand 0.5rem (8px) for shadcn; --radius-frame 0.25rem on landing images. Kept as-is: radius is outside the scope of this sync (layout, rhythm, typography only).

shadow.observed: none found in base stylesheet (no box-shadow declarations)
shadow.majida: --shadow-glow still used on Hero CTA and arch frame. Kept as-is: shadows are outside the scope of this sync.

editorial-patterns.section-eyebrow: 01 / SECTION NAME — small caps, semibold, wide-tracked. Confirmed on site (.eyebrow).
editorial-patterns.heading-italic: last 1–2 words wrapped in <em>. Confirmed on site (27 <em> in headings).
editorial-patterns.rule-under-heading: 1px gradient hairline, 4rem wide, below section heading (MAJIDA rule-gilded). Not seen on honey site; kept as a MAJIDA signature.
editorial-patterns.index-numbers: MAJIDA: large low-weight 01/02/03 in accent at card top-start. Honey site uses small muted numerals (.number ~10px).
editorial-patterns.arrow-links: ↗︎ on outbound/action links, ↓ on anchor-scroll links. Confirmed on site.
editorial-patterns.text-link-hairline: text link underlined by a 1px hairline (border-bottom). Confirmed on site (.text-link).
editorial-patterns.dot-separators: · (middle dot) between service pills, aria-hidden. Confirmed on site (32 uses).
editorial-patterns.ornamental: ✳ between list items / footer links. Confirmed on site in service detail lists and MAJIDA footer.
editorial-patterns.quote-glyph: decorative “ (U+201C) in a span aria-hidden at card top-start for testimonials. Confirmed on site (.quote-mark, aria-hidden).
